claims: Paul Thomas Anderson won Best Adapted Screenplay for One Battle After Another at the 98th Academy Awards.
Paul Thomas Anderson won Best Director for One Battle After Another at the 98th Academy Awards.
Paul Thomas Anderson won Best Picture via his production duties on One Battle After Another at the 98th Academy Awards.
Paul Thomas Anderson's wins at the 98th Academy Awards marked his first Academy Award victories.
Paul Thomas Anderson had over 14 nominations spanning a 30-year career.
